description: Fetch one Instagram post or Reel by its URL or shortcode: caption, media, username, timestamp, like_count, comments_count and view_count. Give exactly one of `url` or `shortcode`. Costs 3 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

shortcode.description: The shortcode from the URL, e.g. `C1a2B3c4D5e`.

name: get_instagram_post
title: Get one Instagram post
